reported_success.quote: One out of the three biomarker findings fully replicated, wherein females with SUD exhibited lower CRP concentrations than females without SUD.

notes: Original locator Table 2 selects females. Replication uses the corresponding adjusted model in Table 1, not its one-predictor post-hoc model. Replication narrative prints p = .002 whereas its Table 1 prints <.01 for the same coefficient; exact narrative p retained. Original Table 2 p bound retained exactly as printed. SUD+ coding is 1 versus SUD− coding 0.
